records.title: CN1 website
records.body: According to my latest lab database entry (November 3), the redesigned CN1 homepage and dedicated Community Arcade and Shop presentation pages have been prepared for review. The official CN1 Club YouTube channel is in the new navigation, and real existing Club 3D and MUTANT media are selected. The updated site is not published yet. Arcade submissions, voting, live Shop products and checkout are not active. No public preview or release date is confirmed.

records.title: CN1 MUTANT and The Lab
records.body: Owner-reported: private R7.4A lab preview uses real textured 3D reactor and cybernetic seed models after offline R5. Model framing and home-page sync still need work. GENESIS is one shared creature; its 14-day reveal is relative to a future official start, not now. No public game, live votes/evolution, NFT, paid XP or guild integration is confirmed.

records.title: NEX assistant and how to ask
records.body: Owner-observed November 3: NEX answers direct member project questions and receives one-off, in-character CN1 orders in the Telegram pilot. It uses dated public records, not live game telemetry. CN1 retains her own persona; NEX cannot change XP, moderation, guilds, or reveal private owner notes.

records.title: CN1 the CLUB
records.body: The CLUB is an owner-reported live and evolving 3D social/music space, according to the public CN1 status of 2026-09-29. Avatars, game-room activity and social features continue to evolve. This does not confirm that every arcade station, multiplayer feature, roulette variant or reward is publicly accessible in every build.

records.title: CN1 Demon Drift
records.body: The owner reported Chapter I publicly released by 2026-10-31. Later chapters remain in development, with a focus on better movement, discovery and companion-led clues. Guild integrations and later-story features are design work, not confirmed live. Check the official Arcade for current playable access.

records.title: CN1 BAD DECISIONS
records.body: The owner has tested Room 1 combat updates and experiments for later areas including Liquidity Mall and a DOOM-like room. Loot, Scrap, crafting and equipment upgrades are under development; do not assume planned trading, shared XP or every prototype room is live.

records.title: Lower Rooms
records.body: Owner-reported private technical tests included room create/join, human 1v1 combat, avatars, damage, kills, respawn and combat effects. Broader multiplayer work continues. Full public 2v2 availability is not verified by this checkpoint.

records.title: CN1 guilds
records.body: The owner reported a limited private Guilds R16 beta with help and read-only NFT-related functions. Links to Demon Drift, shared items and guild resource systems remain staged work. Public signup, XP entitlement and unrestricted transfers are not established.

records.title: CN1 DJ Lab
records.body: The owner tested a multi-minute mixing timeline and work on easier sound selection, audio handling and interface design. This remains an experimental workstream; the exact deployed build, audio quality and public access need a separate current check.

records.title: CN1 Comics and Sunday stories
records.body: The CN1 comic/BD series has recurring Sunday publications shared by its creator through community channels. Its art direction and humor connect to CN1's larger universe. A specific future episode, numbering or public release time should not be assumed from this archived record.
